plans.title: Plans
plans.body: A plan runs django-dbs, archives folders or collects existing files of this application on a schedule, and keeps the newest backups.

pause.done: Plan paused. It runs only from Run now until it is resumed.

resume.done: Plan resumed. It runs at its next time after now; runs missed while it was paused are not made up.

reschedule.title: Reschedule the plan
reschedule.body: Choose when {name} runs next. Later runs follow from that moment.

delete.confirmBody: The plan stops running. Its backups stay listed until someone deletes them.

empty.title: No plans yet
empty.body: A plan backs up this application on a schedule and keeps the newest backups.

kindHint.dbs: django-dbs backs up the project's data and the files its models point at. The application's backup passphrase encrypts each backup.
kindHint.archive: The plan packs the folders into one archive, kept here encrypted. django-dbs backups already include the files their models point at.
kindHint.collect: The plan collects new files that match the pattern from one folder. Each is kept here encrypted, and the server's copy stays as it is.

form.pathsHint: Full paths on the server. Press Enter after each one.
form.folderHint: A full path on the server.
form.patternHint: The * stands for any text, so *.sql.gz matches every .sql.gz file in the folder.
form.name: Name
form.scheduleHint: A manual plan runs only from Run now.
form.firstRunHint: Optional. Without it, the first run is one interval after saving.
form.nextRunHint: Leave it empty to keep the plan's times. A new moment moves them: later runs follow from it.
form.timeZoneHint: Daily and weekly plans keep their local time when the clocks change for daylight saving time.
form.keepHint: Up to 5 of this plan's newest backups stay here. Older ones are deleted after each run.
form.keepRemoteHint: 0 removes the server's copy once it is fetched.
form.enabledHint: Off pauses the plan: it runs only from Run now.
form.passwordHint: Choosing the folders and files this plan copies from the server needs your password.
form.passwordHintFewer: Keeping fewer backups deletes the oldest ones on the next run, so it needs your password.

take.body: A one-off backup belongs to no plan. The manager keeps the five newest. Plans are on the Schedule tab.
take.running: A backup is running. It continues if you leave this page.
take.resumed: Backup finished. The connection broke on the way, and the backup resumed where it stopped.
take.keptOnServer: The connection broke before the backup arrived. The server keeps it, and the manager collects it at the next connection.

warning.files_changed: Backup finished. Some files changed while they were archived.

validation.quarantinedBody: Failed verification when it arrived. It is kept aside, never restored, and never counted toward how many are kept.

prompt.title: Download backup
prompt.body: DBS keeps {name} encrypted. Enter your password to download it decrypted.

restore.label: Restore {name}
restore.title: Restore backup
restore.body: Restoring loads this backup into the application's database and files. A rehearsal runs the whole restore, then rolls it back.
restore.targetHint: To restore onto another application, choose it here.

modeHint.merge: Records added since this backup stay.
modeHint.replace: The backed-up tables are cleared first. Records added since this backup are lost.

restore.passwordHint: Restoring needs your password. A rehearsal does not.
restore.healed: A damaged copy in the backup was repaired.
restore.copyLeft: The copy sent to the server is still at {path}.

prompt.title: Delete backup
prompt.body: Enter your password to delete {name}. Undo is offered right after it is deleted.

empty.title: No backups yet
empty.body: django-dbs backups need django-dbs in the application. The check on Overview shows whether it is installed.

all.title: Backups
all.subtitle: Every application's backups, and the space they take in the manager.
all.filesBody: Newest first. Each backup belongs to the application it was taken from.
all.empty: Backups appear here once an application has one.

noMatch.title: No backups for this application
noMatch.body: Choose another application, or show every application's backups.

storage.title: Storage
storage.body: The space the backups kept in the manager take, in all and for each application.
storage.label: Storage by application
storage.low: The disk that holds the manager's backups is nearly full. Free some space before the next backup needs it.

errors.invalid_interval: Choose a schedule from the list.
errors.invalid_time_zone: Choose a time zone from the list, such as Europe/Berlin.
errors.invalid_moment: Choose a moment after now and within a year.
errors.manual_plan: This plan runs only from Run now. Give it a schedule first.
errors.paths_not_allowed: A django-dbs plan takes no folders.
errors.invalid_pattern: Use a pattern with no / in it.
errors.name_mismatch: Type the application's name exactly as shown.
errors.not_restorable: Only a django-dbs backup can be restored.
errors.backup_lost_on_server: The connection broke while the backup was arriving, and the server did not finish it. Nothing was kept. Try again.
